title: A Family Needs More Than Rescue Understanding Nepal’s Flood Emergency
excerpt: The floodwater has gone down. A family returns to find their home damaged. The road to the market is gone. The tap no longer provides safe water. What do they do first? This is why Nepal disaster relief must look at a family’s whole day. Food, water, shelter, and medical care all matter. Losing access to one can make the others harder to manage. Why Is Safe Water an Immediate Need? The August 2026
